experience.role: Software Engineer, DevOps Engineer & Technical Consultant
details: Work across software engineering, DevOps, and technical consulting for defence technology projects focused on technology indigenisation and field deployment.
Develop AI-based detection and surveillance systems by integrating computer vision models, backend APIs, dashboards, and containerized services.
Support technical evaluation, system integration, and solution documentation for UAVs, power electronics, and other defence applications.
Developed facial recognition pipelines using deep learning, image embeddings, and OpenCV.
Built livestock identity models and worked across dataset preparation, annotation, CNN training, and edge-device inference optimization.

experience.role: Data Science and MERN Stack Developer Trainee
details: Completed AICTE & ICAC approved training in data science and full-stack development, covering preprocessing, model development, REST APIs, and component-based interfaces.
Built Python analytics workflows and MERN application components using MongoDB, Express.js, React, and Node.js.

projects.title: Argus
projects.description: Built a self-hosted surveillance platform that batches YOLO/OpenVINO inference across multiple camera streams and tracks people inside configurable regions of interest. Implemented contextual risk scoring, authenticated WebSocket alerts, WebRTC playback through MediaMTX, and tenant-aware APIs, then containerized the stack with Docker Compose and deployed it on AWS EC2 behind an Nginx reverse proxy.

projects.title: GeMSentry
projects.description: Automated GeM tender discovery with configurable keyword searches, date filtering, PDF downloads, and extraction of EMD, exemption, pre-bid, and ePBG details. Built a Flask and SQLite review dashboard with bid scoring, status workflows, cached document access, authenticated APIs, pytest coverage, and Google Sheets synchronization.

projects.title: Panox V2
projects.description: Engineered a dual-fisheye-to-equirectangular video pipeline with ORB/RANSAC alignment, adaptive seams, multi-band blending, batch export, and spherical metadata injection. Added hardware detection, optional CUDA/NVENC acceleration, automatic CPU fallback, configuration presets, and CI tests across Python 3.10 and 3.12.

projects.title: PhishGuard 2.0 Model Trainer
projects.description: Developed a phishing-URL training pipeline that harmonizes more than 1.2 million labeled records and extracts 30 lexical and domain-specific security features. Combined LightGBM, a PyTorch residual network, and character n-gram TF-IDF models through calibrated mixture-of-experts scoring with CPU fallback and FP16 GPU support.

projects.title: Multi-Modal Binary Malware Analysis
projects.description: Implemented opcode Transformer, control-flow graph GIN, and system-call BiLSTM encoders with contrastive alignment and attention-weighted fusion. Added two-stage static and dynamic triage, missing-modality gating, FAISS similarity search, experiment-backed metrics, and a Streamlit research dashboard.

projects.title: PDFZen
projects.description: Created a privacy-focused PDF application with in-browser merge, split, compression, organization, rotation, cropping, watermarking, and page-numbering tools. Implemented a local FastAPI conversion backend for PDF-to-Word, Excel, PowerPoint, image, and Markdown workflows using pdf2docx, pandas, PyMuPDF, and LibreOffice.
